messages:
Javi: FYI — after last week's kernel-selector tweak, our route `chat-stream` prefix cache hit-rate fell from ~82% to ~66% in prod. Built a quick observability spec and sampling plan.
Maya: saw the grafana alert. can you paste the top query? want tenant split.
Javi: main token-saved formula I prototyped:
```
sum by(tenant,route,model) (increase(prefix_tokens_saved_total[1h]))
```
and hit-rate:
```
sum by(tenant,route,model) (increase(prefix_hits_total[1h]))
/ sum by(tenant,route,model) (increase(requests_total[1h]))
```
Added labels: kernel_tag, batch_size_bucket, kv_cache_age_bucket.
Ron: please capture kv_cache_age_seconds hist too — we need per-gpu warmup curves.
Sophie: privacy check — never log unhashed prompt keys. require HMAC-SHA256 with per-cluster salt, store 8-char fingerprint for dashboards only.
Javi: plan: sample 1% of hashed fingerprints + full metadata (model_version, route, tenant, kernel_tag, batch_size, response_len_bucket) to a locked s3 bucket encrypted by KMS. rotate salt quarterly.
Carlos: on top fingerprints panel, show median tokens_saved_per_hit and p90 latency impact. prioritize fingerprints that save >100k tokens/week.
Maya: i'll implement tokens-saved heatmap and per-tenant token-saved leaderboards. ETA 36h.
Ron: i'll add kernel vs hit-rate scatter and batching bucket panels; will include an option to overlay last-14d baseline.
Sophie: approve 1% sampling so long as retention is 90 days and access is audited. i'll draft the policy and the log schema.
perf-bot: alert: prefix_cache_hitrate_drop on chat-stream. baseline 82% -> current 66% (detected: 2026-03-16T09:14:00Z).
Javi: proposed runbook: 1) auto-pin affected tenant traffic to last-known-good kernel build for 30m when tenant hit-rate drops >15%; 2) run an immediate sample dump and post median tokens-saved diffs; 3) page on-call if global token-saved drop >25% for 15m.
Maya: for noisy tenants, require min 5k tokens generated in window before alerting.
Carlos: i'll wire up a nightly slack report with top regressions by tenant + suggested mitigations.
Javi: owners: maya -> panels + dashboard draft; ron -> kernel/batch panels; sophie -> privacy + sampling policy; carlos -> regression report + daily job. i'll open a dashboard RFC and link it here.
Maya: tagging this thread once draft pushed. :thumbsup:
Javi: thanks team. preserving hashed fingerprints only in dashboard exports. will follow up with RFC link tomorrow.
